bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 9 月底部

read.en: AAOI fell 11.8% on Oct 14 to $86.22 on heavy volume and is down 30% in five sessions. It is below every average: the 5-day ($100.0), 10-day ($109.7), falling 30-day ($104.7), 200-day ($111.8) and falling 100-day ($127.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($129.1), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: AAOI 10月14日放量下跌 11.8%，收于 $86.22，五个交易日下跌 30%。股价位于所有均线下方：5 日（$100.0）、10 日（$109.7）、下行的 30 日（$104.7）、200 日（$111.8）以及下行的 100 日均线（$127.1）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$129.1），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The September floor ($93.6–97), which had held three times, broke on the close and is now first resistance; the day's low was $85.75. Next support is $84.6 (March low), then $76 (Jul 29 swing low). Above the floor, resistance is $100 (5-day average) and $105 (30-day average). A close below $84.6 would open $76.
read.zh: 此前三次守住的 9月底部（$93.6–97）收盘失守，现转为第一阻力；当日低点 $85.75。下一支撑为 $84.6（3月低点），其次 $76（7月29日波段低点）。底部区域之上，阻力为 $100（5 日均线）和 $105（30 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $84.6，下一目标看 $76。
